name: RPM International Inc.
moat_justification: Portfolio of #1/#2 niche brands (Rust-Oleum, DAP, Tremco, Carboline, Stonhard) with shelf-space and commercial specification positions and proven pricing power (gross margin 36.3% FY2022 to 41.4% FY2025-26, ROE 20-29% FY2021-26 in fundamentals.json), but no network effects, low consumer switching costs, larger scaled rivals, and raw-material cyclicality; roic_proxy is null in fundamentals.json (operating income untagged), so a 7+ moat is not evidenced.
fragility_flags: OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 3.3x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (6.6%) vs bull-case tier C (10.6%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Quality niche-brand coatings compounder, moat 5/10 — but cyclical OE and 3.3x net debt at $99.73 give only an 8.4% weighted IRR (IV@15% $46.16); it clears 15% only below ~$46.
moat_for: Leading #1/#2 niche brands: Rust-Oleum, DAP, Tremco, Carboline, Stonhard
Commercial specification and warranted-system selling creates switching friction (Tremco roofing/building envelope)
Pricing power proven: gross margin recovered 36.3% (FY2022) to 41.4% (FY2025-26)
Diversified repair-and-maintenance demand across construction, industrial and consumer markets
moat_against: Consumer DIY products have low switching costs; shelf space contested by Sherwin-Williams, PPG and private label
No network effects or structural cost advantage vs larger coatings rivals
Raw-material inflation outran pricing again in Q1 FY2027 (gross margin down 100bp)
Construction-cycle exposure: Construction Products organic sales fell 1.7% in Q1 FY2027
Acquisition-led model: goodwill/intangibles load and a serial deal cadence to sustain growth
